tidbit: Did you know… about 13,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Cognitum One has released Ruflo, an agent orchestration tool for Claude Code and Codex. According to the Corsicana Daily Sun, Confirmed: the system enables end-to-end agent workflows with human approval for engineering tasks.
NetBox Labs has partnered with NVIDIA and Grafana Labs to expand its Infrastructure Intelligence Platform. The Star reports Confirmed: the expansion includes new tools for design and observability to assemble an intelligence layer.
Nvidia's share of China's chip market has dropped to 34 percent as Huawei's shipments nearly double to 572,000. kucoin reports Confirmed: Huawei is gaining ground against Nvidia in the region.
SpaceX Super Intelligence has bundled X Premium, Grok and Cursor into one subscription service. TechCrunch reports Confirmed: the bundle launches with five subscription tiers.
Nvidia is launching artificial intelligence models and gaming upgrades ahead of its RTX Spark laptop sale on October 16. SMBtech Reported: the company is rolling out a software update for the new laptops.
Free every hour.
